description: The file defines a PHP class 'InfoSubController' in the namespace 'Goteo\Controller\Admin'. This class manages administrative actions related to 'info' entries, including CRUD operations, permission checks, and event logging, for the 'ideas about' or 'info' sections within the application.

classes.name: InfoSubController
classes.description: Controller handling administrative operations for 'info' entries, including permissions, actions (add, edit, remove, list, translate), and processing form submissions and updates.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform actions in a given node, allowing only superadmin or root roles on the master node.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the 'translate' action by delegating to the 'process' method with 'translate' as the action parameter.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the 'add' action, delegating to 'process' with 'add'.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the 'edit' action, delegating to 'process' with 'edit'.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Handles moving an info item up in order, delegating to 'process'.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Handles moving an info item down in order, delegating to 'process'.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Handles removing an info item, delegating to 'process'.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing info items, delegating to 'process'.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes different actions ('list', 'add', 'edit', 'remove', 'up', 'down', 'translate') related to 'info' entries, including handling form submissions, saving data, deleting entries, and preparing data for views.
